description: Source code for the 'iron-icon' web component, a Polymer element that displays icons with customizable styling and icon sources.

classes.name: iron-icon
classes.description: A Polymer web component that displays an icon, supporting icon sets and custom images.

methods.name: _iconChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the 'icon' property, parsing iconset and icon name.

methods.name: _srcChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the 'src' property, updating the image source.

methods.name: _usesIconset
methods.description: Determines whether to use an iconset or a custom image based on properties.

methods.name: _updateIcon
methods.description: Updates the displayed icon based on current properties, either from iconset or image source.
